Screen translation on device when enterprise-managed, offline or on a metered network. General chat on device only when offline. Driver updates and support chat use the cloud. Confirmation: always for driver updates; for performance mode on battery below 20%; for privacy changes on enterprise-managed PCs; for meeting recording; and for general chat on a metered network.

criteria.smart_power: Performance, quiet and battery-saver power modes
criteria.display_eye_care: Brightness, blue-light filter and eye-care reminders
criteria.audio_enhance: Microphone noise suppression and voice clarity
criteria.camera_studio: Background blur, auto framing and lighting correction
criteria.meeting_assist: Meeting transcripts, recordings, summaries and action items
criteria.file_search: Find local files by what they contain
criteria.screen_translate: Translate text or speech on the screen
criteria.driver_update: Check and install drivers and firmware
criteria.system_diagnose: Health checks for battery, fans, disk and performance
criteria.privacy_shield: Screen privacy, auto-lock and hiding notifications
criteria.smart_connect: Phone link: transfer files and photos, mirror notifications
criteria.support_chat: Contact Contoso support about warranty or repairs
criteria.general_chat: General questions, writing help and chit-chat
criteria.none_reject: Out of scope or not allowed; decline politely
